name: comm
description: Example ORDERED-SINK plugin — a stand-in for a comm / PLC / MES forwarder. Marked "sink": true, so the host STAGES a script's xi::use("<this>").push(pack) and flushes it AFTER the inspect, inside the ordered-emit gate. The packs arrive at this plugin's xi.pack@1 door in FRAME (arrival) order even under parallel dispatch (dispatch_threads > 1), instead of completion order. Each delivery carries the reserved i64 entry "$seq" (the frame's arrival id) for correlation / gap detection. A real comm plugin would forward each pack's entries to the line here; this demo records the $seq it received, in order, and exposes it via exchange("get_received").

inputs.name: any
inputs.doc: any sealed pack + i64 "$seq" (frame arrival id, stamped before seal)

exchange.doc: -> {received:[seq,...], count} — the $seq values seen, in delivery order
